EP11:E74 88000-90000 ALEXANDER [V.O.) (Pained, Selfless]: "But one blow would destroy her life."

EP11:E76 91000-92200 ACTION: The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.
EP11:E77 92100-93200 JULIANA [Startled, Shouting]: "That is his coat!"

EP11:E79 95800-97000 SOUND: Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
EP11:E80 96800-99200 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.
EP11:E81 97200-99000 ACTION: Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
EP11:E82 99200-102000 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.
EP11:E83 102000-106800 CAMERA: Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.
EP11:E84 104200-106600 GERALD [Gloating, Victorious]: "There it is. Ha!"
